svg.title: Kit: an encrypted business request through Handle
svg.desc: Access or session/guard rejection prevents resolve. Transport encrypts normal responses and errors produced inside its boundary, followed by audit and response headers. Custom middleware must not treat encrypted bytes as business input; endpoints or load/actions still validate application data.
svg.metadata: flowchart TB A["Request: trace ID, locale, trusted source and access decision"] B["Transport: bounded read, authenticate and decrypt"] C["Enforce access decision; resolve session; run guards"] D["Middleware chain → resolve(event)"] E["Transport: encrypt and authenticate response"] F["Finalize audit, security and trace headers"] X["Denial or error response; skip business execution"] A --> B B --> C C -->|"allowed"| D C -->|"denied"| X D --> E X --> E E --> F classDef default fill:#edf3ff,stroke:#476aab,color:#172b4d,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef good fill:#e9f6ef,stroke:#28734e,color:#17452f,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef stop fill:#fff0f0,stroke:#af4040,color:#742b2b,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef pending fill:#fff6df,stroke:#a07827,color:#654b18,stroke-width:1.5px; class F good; class X stop;

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif
